prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Predictions were generally overly optimistic, though they underestimated improvements from choose path layout updates, select new flows, and notification additions.
Reordering sign-in (sign_in, reorder) was helpful in three winning tests, though specific placements showed no clear effect or hurt performance.
Choose path layout updates (choose_path, layout) were helpful in two winning tests, though other variants showed no clear effect or hurt performance.
Sign-in copy tweaks (sign_in, copy), finish hints (finish, hint), finish incentives (finish, incentive), and home hints (home, hint) showed no clear effect across multiple tests.
Adding a new finish screen (finish, new_screen) hurt performance or showed no clear effect across multiple tests.
Evidence remains thin for change kinds tested only once, requiring at least 2 tests to establish a clear pattern.

Changes:
0: [choose_path, redesign] Choose Path Stage Layout Redesign: Redesign the choose_path screen into a stage layout featuring an animated mascot and high-visibility choice cards. (why: Choose path drops 21.5% of users with high mean duration (514s); choose path layout updates previously showed strong conversion gains.)
1: [sign_in, notification] Sign In Account Cloud Sync Notification: Display a cloud sync status badge and explicit hint text on the sign-in screen reassuring users that pet data is saved. (why: 8 support emails complained about pets missing or being reset after signing back in.)
2: [adoption, new_flow] Pick Friend Interactive Preview Flow: Add pet animation previews, behavior video clips, and audio samples directly to the pet choice screen. (why: Adoption has the lowest conversion rate at 69.6% with high median (89s) and mean (1017s) setup times.)
3: [home, wait_info] Waiting Screen Desktop Readiness Checklist: Add a real-time progress bar and desktop setup checklist items while custom pet assets finish generating. (why: Users spend a long time waiting (median 201s, mean 2336s) and 3 emails reported pets failing to appear on desktop.)
4: [finish, redesign] Home Intro Spotlight Layout Redesign: Rebuild the home intro screen into a spotlight layout with companion control guide buttons. (why: Finish conversion drops to 71.4% with a mean duration of 5815s, and 3 support emails reported confusion controlling the pet.)
5: [choose_path, layout] Story Screen Carousel Layout Refresh: Transform the intro story screen into a carousel layout with progress step counter and animated welcome banner. (why: Improving visual pacing on the initial story screen helps drive early funnel engagement before path selection.)
6: [adoption, layout] Upload Photos Two Column Layout: Switch the custom photo upload step to a two-column layout with explicit photo picker and tip text. (why: 3 support emails reported custom pet generation failing or looking incorrect.)
7: [home, notification] Waiting Screen Desktop Launch Audio Notification: Add an active notify-when-ready toggle and chime sound trigger to the waiting screen. (why: Waiting step takes a mean 2336s; notifying users when processing finishes brings them back to complete setup.)
8: [finish, redesign] Home Intro Two Column Layout Redesign: Rebuild the final home intro screen using a two-column layout featuring a guide mascot and action button. (why: 3 support emails indicated confusion after onboarding regarding pet controls and visibility.)
